all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @EaglesXsandOs
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Separate EPA (point value of the state change) from leverage/WPA (what the state change is worth in win probability). Weight plays by game state when the target is winning or team

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @ScottKacsmar
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: The price of a yard is set by down and distance. Never credit a play's yards without the state it started in; short-of-the-sticks gains late in a series are worth far more than the

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @zxcvbnmwill
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Value is the change in state, not the yardage. Any feature built on raw yards without the before/after state is measuring the wrong thing.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @galenhall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Near the goal lines, price the failure state, not just the conversion. Red-zone and backed-up states need their own baselines; a flat model mis-ranks both plays and decisions there

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @ArkansasQuant
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Evaluate decisions by the delta versus the alternative, never by the absolute success rate. Leverage is a gap, not a level.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @BenjaminSolak
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Judge decisions by the ex-ante WP delta (+14.5%), not by the outcome that followed. Resulting is a training-data poison: a correct go that fails is still a correct go.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @Timo_NFL
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Edge states (1 second left, kneel-out clocks, OT) are separate regimes, not the tail of the mid-game distribution. The same nominal choice is a different decision depending on whic

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @bburkeESPN
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Decision rule — compute p × WP(success) + (1−p) × WP(failure) and compare it to WP(kick/punt). "Punt" is never a default; it is one branch among three, priced like the others.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @tejfbanalytics
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Track cumulative decision WPA. A coach/team decision tendency is a measurable, persistent quantity — small per-play leaks are a real signal, not noise.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @nfl4thbot
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Do not treat early-game decisions as low-stakes by default. Price every 4th down in WP; the coach's conservative lean is not evidence the model is wrong.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @dwainmcfarland
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Learn a team-specific offset from the script-conditioned expectation. Score changes the play call in a predictable direction, but the size of the shift is a team trait.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @LateRoundQB
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Estimate pace, pass rate, and efficiency in close games first (margin within ~6, or WP roughly 20–80%). That is the team prior; extreme scripts are a separate state.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @grok
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Train on residuals versus expected pass rate given score, down, and distance (PROE), not on raw attempt shares. (Provenance note: this post is from X's own AI account summarizing t

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @PurpyNFL
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Any feature built from attempt counts must be script-adjusted before it enters a model, or it encodes the schedule of scores the team happened to face.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @PurpyNFL
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Exclude or reclassify kneel-downs, sacks, and scrambles before estimating script effects or team tendencies.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @bjT98504
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Condition run-defense evaluation on score and leverage, or the ranking will track opponent script rather than defensive quality.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @Moneylinehacks
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Do not treat rush or pass attempts as exogenous inputs when predicting points, spreads, or player yardage. Volume and team success are jointly determined by script.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @LinkofSunshine
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Any pass-volume feature must carry the score state with it, or the model will learn the arrow of causality backwards.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @hawkblogger
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Shrink extreme-script rates hard when a team rarely trails or rarely leads. Never pool trailing EPA with leading EPA.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @NFLSnapIQ
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: The neutral-script early-down split is the diagnostic view. Build it before drawing any conclusion about coaching philosophy.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @BAI8app
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Do not average across states. Reweight to a common script distribution before ranking teams or feeding a predictive feature.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @RoyRobi73192051
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Encode the base rule as the expectation; measure every team and game as a deviation from it.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @SharpFootball
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Define the red zone as its own state (inside the 20, goal-to-go nested inside it) and score the drive outcome — TD vs FG vs nothing — separately from the yards earned getting there

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @GridironInfo_
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Keep red-zone EPA as a split feature for both offense and defense; never let full-field EPA stand in for it.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @SharpFootball
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Within the red zone, split by down. An aggregate red-zone number can hide the exact down where the offense breaks.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @TheJetPress
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Full-field explosiveness does not imply finishing ability. Model the red zone as a distinct regime with its own team ratings.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @dmlr53
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Backed-up is a negative-EP state; value plays from it in EP/EPA, never raw yards, or the model overvalues empty yardage from bad field position.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @officialctpod
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Fourth-down conversion priors must be era-current and distance-specific; stale priors systematically under-price going for it.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @thatcaden_
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Treat distance-to-go as a first-class, continuous feature on 3rd/4th down. "Long" is a probability, not a verdict.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @GridironInfo_
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: The two-minute drill is its own efficiency regime. Condition on clock, timeouts, and score; do not borrow neutral-script play values into it.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @YUNOsports_NFL
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Carry a clutch/two-minute conversion split for offense and defense separately from overall third-down rates.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @RedlineFootball
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: State the WP band any EPA feature was computed on (common operational garbage-time definitions: WP outside ~5–95% or ~10–90%, or 17+ down in Q4). Rankings without the filter defini

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @goblue_mike
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: States are dynamic. A large point swing in a short window moves the game out of the prevent regime — re-classify the state instead of averaging the whole stretch as "garbage time.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @LordReebs
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Player efficiency features must be state-split. A QB's red-zone TD/INT profile is a separate quantity from his overall line and can diverge sharply.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @RyanPaganetti
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Price the full WP of go vs punt with branch values (WP after success ≈ 71%, after failure ≈ 29%), not conversion rate alone. A modest conversion chance still wins when the alternat

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @BenjaminSolak
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Always price all three branches. In long-field-goal range late in a tie, the field goal can be dominated by both alternatives.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @billbarnwell
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Historical base rates in narrow state bins are strong priors. When a coach deviates from a near-unanimous bin, the burden of proof is on the deviation.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @NextGenStats
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: No state is categorically off-limits to the EV computation. Compute the branches everywhere; let the numbers, not field-position folklore, draw the lines.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @BenjaminSolak
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: When both branches require the same defensive outcome, the go branch weakly dominates. Compare what each branch actually changes, not the labels "aggressive" vs "safe."

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @MikeReiss
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Score margin interacts with the kick/go choice: a field goal that leaves you still trailing by two scores is worth less than its points. Model the margin after each branch, not jus

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @Timo_NFL
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Score, clock, and opponent timeouts interact. "Take the points" is not a terminal state; price the game that follows the kick.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @nfl4thbot
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: A coach's conservative lean is not automatically justified by information the model lacks. Several-point WP edges are rarely overturned by personnel adjustments (backup QB, kicker

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @SharpFootball
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Personnel is a prior on the defensive response, not just an offensive label. Model the response (base vs nickel, box, shell) as part of the play's context.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @Michael_Nania
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Expected production is team-by-package specific. A single team efficiency number that ignores personnel mix blends away the actual signal.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @Bumi_mind
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Split run and pass expectations by package and encode the interaction. A personnel main effect without the run/pass interaction will be wrong in both directions.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @sambruchhaus
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Condition on the receiving threat of TE2/FB (target rate, receiving grade), not just the personnel label. The label alone does not determine the defensive price.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @JonnyPage9
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Expected rush value depends on personnel AND the box and width it creates. Include formation width (spread vs condensed) as a feature alongside personnel.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @RyanPaganetti
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Coverage shell is part of the same tradeoff as personnel. Predict shell from personnel (and vice versa), then predict EPA conditional on the shell.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @HoodBall_15
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: The value of heavy personnel is partly the conflict it imposes, not the bodies themselves. Features should capture gap count and LB conflict, not only box count.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @Kovb41
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Never use box count as a standalone feature. Its effect is an interaction with personnel and era; model it as such.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @popofansports
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Credit for beating a heavy box should be adjusted for whether the offense forced that box or simply declared heavy and ran into the natural response.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @CaseL731
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Usage is endogenous — defenses price tendencies in. Residual EPA after conditioning on personnel, down-and-distance, and defensive response is closer to skill than raw EPA by perso

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @SalVetriDFS
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Condition skill-player volume and efficiency on the specific quarterback, game by game. A starter/backup flag is too coarse — the identity of the QB is the feature.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @KyleM_FF
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Do not apply a uniform backup-QB penalty. Target share and per-route efficiency can survive the QB change while TD rate does not; model the components separately, by player.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @weatherqb
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Apply player-specific weather interactions measured against each player's own baseline, never a single game-level weather penalty.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @weatherqb
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Wind speed (with a ~15 mph threshold) should directly cut QB/WR/kicker expectations. Do not transfer the lost passing value to running backs by assumption.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @AlexCaruso
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Model weather as an interaction with the player's own history and home environment, not as a main effect applied to everyone equally.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @SharpFootball
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Days-of-rest difference and short-week indicators are material features. Flag extreme differentials (multiple days, repeated short weeks, opponents off byes) explicitly.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @JusttheFoosball
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Treat OL availability as a first-class, graded feature: number of starters out, replacement quality (veteran vs rookie), and injury vs coach's-decision. It should shift expected QB

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @CynicalPublius
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Altitude is an acclimatization effect, asymmetric by team and by half. Model visitor performance decay at elevation venues rather than a flat venue penalty.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @TheNumbersDesk
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Rest belongs in the strength prior, but a model should not expect a large, consistent betting edge from rest alone. Distinguish "this changes expected performance" from "this be

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @trenchpower2025
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Track injury context beyond the binary out/active label — practice participation, injury type, and playing-through-it status all change expected performance even when the player is

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @AdamKoffler
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Forecast wind speed and precipitation should directly lower expected points, especially outdoors. Weather hits totals more than spreads.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @MrMathBet
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Confirmed QB absence is a first-order repricing event (team strength and scoring rate, immediately). Score injury clusters, not single absences. A move against the public ticket sp

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @offshoreinsider
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: QB-to-IR is not a flag, it is a multi-point team-strength rewrite applied immediately. Moves of this size with a confirmed availability cause should be treated as information-compl

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @SBD
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Availability news propagates across markets at once. Cross-market consistency is a check on whether a move is news-driven or flow-driven.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @BTBSportsIntel
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Unexplained moves are information. Do not assume every move has a fully observed public driver at the moment it happens; soft availability signals belong in the model before offici

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @kukluxkraut
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Weight moves by the numbers they cross. A move through 3 or 7 is stronger evidence than an equal move elsewhere, and overshoot past a key is a fade candidate once the news is alrea

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @fredwinss_
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Short-week and rest-differential indicators belong in the pre-move prior — the market applies them before any news arrives.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @QcrackinBookies
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Context factors compound. Price weather and venue together; a total move can be the sum of two situational inputs, neither of which is team news.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @statsowar
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: A yard is not a yard. Score plays against pre-snap expected points (down, distance, field position), not absolute yards.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @ArifHasanNFL
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Prefer per-play rates over totals for any quality judgment, and carry the script context with any volume feature.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @ARKNDJL
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Completion percentage is not accuracy. Condition on air yards/aDOT, designed YAC, and throw difficulty (CPOE or depth bins) before comparing passers.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @AccidentalZen
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Adjust defensive yardage for opponent run/pass mix and opponent quality, or use success-rate / adjusted metrics. Never rank a defense on raw yards allowed.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @EaglesXsandOs
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Stack the adjustments: state value (EPA) → leverage (WP context) → opponent quality. Each layer removes a different lie. (Same post as Record 1.1 — the lesson differs by theme.)

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @ScottKacsmar
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Do not treat play EPA as player skill. Split air yards from YAC and be explicit about credit assignment before aggregating plays into player ratings. (Same post as Record 1.2.)

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @KenIngalls
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Yards/play is a rough efficiency proxy, not the full read. The model should hunt the residual: the ~19% of EPA that down, distance, and state explain beyond yardage.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @LordBenne
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Pair yards per play with success rate, negative-play rate, and third-down conversion. Averages without the distribution are a different (worse) statistic.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @Saint_FinX
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Points beat empty yards. The target should be scoring value or EPA; raw yards are a feature, never the verdict.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: @PukaJimmer
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Normalize by opportunity and starting state before any cross-team comparison of totals.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: GSE Emission Firewall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Unpriced Prop Board Circuit Breaker: zero two-sided juice requires mandatory PASS.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: GSE Emission Firewall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Immutable Pregame Direction Freeze (Rule H3 Anti-Flip): pregame direction cannot silently flip without new verified injury/weather.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: GSE Misleading-Stat Firewall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Play-Clock-at-Snap pooled without down stratification is a proven down confound (pooled t=-3.63 collapses to t=+0.02 within down).

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: GSE Misleading-Stat Firewall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Disguise collapse hazard without pre-snap spatial width normalization is confounded by formation width.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: GSE Misleading-Stat Firewall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Cumulative season rushing yards are confounded by carry volume (R^2~0.99); de-confound to per-carry RYOE rate.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: GSE Misleading-Stat Firewall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Stunt/twist pressure rate without OL slide/chip protection context overstates pass-rush disruption.

all_87_reconciled_rules.title: GSE Misleading-Stat Firewall
all_87_reconciled_rules.lesson: Right-censored career cohorts and relative-risk claims without base-rate denominators create spurious edges.
